set(baseaddress_fusion_1_1 ${baseaddress_fusion})

set(fusion_folder "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..")
spec2def(fusion.dll fusion.spec)

# fusion.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/fusion_1_1-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(fusion_1_1 fusion_1_1-cargo fusion.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/Microsoft.NET/Framework/v1.1.4322
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk uuid_sources)
